question: Assemble a synthetic plasmid from dna_parts.fasta using Golden Gate cloning with BsaI, and output a circular construct map with part positions. Assemble parts in the order they appear in the file (part1_promoter -> part2_gene -> part3_terminator -> part4_backbone), digesting with BsaI (recognition site GGTCTC, cuts 1 nt downstream on the sense strand) to generate compatible overhangs for ligation.

expected_output.guidelines: The assembled sequence must match the reference exactly; case and column order may differ.
Total length and per-part positional intervals must match the reference; label formatting and whitespace may differ.
